title: Live Workflow Redaction Evidence

evidence_claims.summary: v1 thumbnail upload intent returns a POST form contract without receiving image bytes in control-plane.
v1 task stop returns stopped_by_user_request immediately as the SaaS-visible state.
testnet smoke verifies the provider path through a daemon-bound runtime agent visible and assignable to the live smoke principal.
testnet smoke verifies device daemon runtime snapshots on v1 and v2 client surfaces without exposing endpoint or token values.
v2 task-scoped thread message POST accepts a selected thread_id and returns that thread_id.
v2 thread collection exposes the task stream href that points at the workspace AI Agent events stream.
v3 thread history returns agent_snapshots as an id-addressed map and thread records reference agent_snapshot_id.
v3 thread history preserves a user follow-up message after refresh through messages[].
source_phrases: v3_followup_body="Please preserve this v3 follow-up after refresh"

evidence_claims.summary: testnet load harness exercises authenticated client-read endpoints with scheduled scenario, duration, and concurrency controls.
testnet load harness publishes redacted live summary evidence and promotes failed runs into closed-loop candidates.
control-plane performance workflow runs lightweight hot-path benchmarks and uploads benchmark evidence without live credentials.
control-plane performance workflow publishes redacted summary evidence and promotes failed runs into closed-loop candidates.

assertions: live workflows may run curl, aws, or docker, but public artifacts must contain only redacted summary evidence
redacted summaries must not include endpoint hosts, AWS resource names, tokens, task definition ARNs, image URIs, or raw response bodies
redacted summaries may include manifest-declared contract claim ids and summaries when the workflow source proves each claim
redacted summaries must publish generated_at and expires_at so stale live evidence cannot be promoted as fresh
public workflow evidence coverage must not need accepted gaps for live smoke or live deploy workflows

loop.observation: The remaining workflow evidence gaps were live smoke and deployment jobs that could not safely publish raw operator output; the smoke summary also hid which frontend-facing contracts were exercised.
loop.hypothesis: A redacted summary sidecar can prove execution shape and contract claim coverage without exporting private endpoint hosts, token, raw response bodies, or AWS topology values.
loop.execute: Verify each live workflow publishes a generated summary artifact through this tool, keep only safe GitHub metadata in that artifact, stamp generated_at/expires_at, and require manifest-declared claim source phrases to exist in the workflow.
loop.evaluate: The verifier fails on missing summary wiring, missing positive TTL, stale generated docs, summary fields outside the redaction contract, claim fields not explicitly allowed, or claim source phrases absent from the workflow.
loop.retrospective: Live workflows can now participate in the evidence loop while exposing enough safe claim coverage for frontend and operations review.
